  • 1. Nāgavagga 1. Dragons

Suddhikasutta Plain Version

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Catasso imā, bhikkhave, nāgayoniyo. “Mendicants, dragons reproduce in these four ways. Katamā catasso? What four? Aṇḍajā nāgā, jalābujā nāgā, saṁsedajā nāgā, opapātikā nāgā—Dragons are born from eggs, from a womb, from moisture, or spontaneously. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso nāgayoniyo”ti. These are the four ways that dragons reproduce.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
